name: Provo CySA+
description: Provo: exam readiness for CompTIA CySA+ (CS0-004). Acronyms, architecture and IAM, indicators of malicious activity, analysis tools, threat intelligence and hunting, automation and AI, vulnerability scanning, prioritization, controls and risk, attack frameworks, incident response, reporting, question qualifiers, mini-exams, and a one-page cram sheet. To add it, choose Tools > Provo CySA+ > Add Provo CySA+ note. It creates a note named Provo CySA+ and opens it in the full-width tool.
author: Benjamin Smith
